title: FieldKit - A customizable touchscreen HUD and control tool
features:
FieldKit — Features

- Touchscreen Controls: Customizable on-screen keyboard inputs and joystick for mobile gameplay.
- Custom HUD Editor: Freely position, resize, reshape, recolor, and adjust the opacity of controls.
- Per-Key Settings: Configure individual hold durations and permanent-hold options.
- Configuration Saving: Save and restore customized control layouts.
- In-Game UI Toggle: Open and close the FieldKit interface using its floating football icon.


How FieldKit Helps Android Players

FieldKit makes gameplay more comfortable on Android by giving players greater control over their touchscreen layout.

- Custom Touch Controls: Use on-screen keyboard inputs and a joystick to make controls more accessible on mobile.
- Personalized HUD: Move, resize, reshape, recolor, and adjust the opacity of controls to suit your screen and playstyle.
- Individual Hold Settings: Configure hold durations and permanent-hold options for supported controls.
- Save Your Layout: Save and reload your preferred control configuration instead of rebuilding it every time.
- Quick UI Access: Open or close FieldKit using the floating football icon without searching for the interface.

The goal: give Android players more flexibility over how they control the game, with a customizable setup that feels more natural on a touchscreen.
